firewall_id.description: The existing firewall ID to use for this cluster

node_count.description: Number of nodes in the nodepool

size.description: Size of the nodes in the nodepool.

label.description: Node pool label, if you don't provide one, we will generate one for you

public_ip_node_pool.description: Node pool belongs to the public ip node pool

taint.type: list(object({effect: string, key: string, value: string}))
taint.description: This attribute allows you to specify taints for nodes in a particular pool, controlling pod scheduling by restricting which pods can be scheduled on those nodes.

applications.description: Comma separated list of applications to install. Spaces within application names are fine, but shouldn't be either side of the comma. Application names are case-sensitive; the available applications can be listed with the Civo CLI: 'civo kubernetes applications ls'. If you want to remove a default installed application, prefix it with a '-', e.g. -Traefik. For application that supports plans, you can use 'app_name:app_plan' format e.g. 'Linkerd:Linkerd & Jaeger' or 'MariaDB:5GB'. View list of apps on the Civo CLI --> civo kubernetes apps ls

cluster_type.description: The type of cluster to create

cni.description: The cni for the k3s to install

name.description: Name for your cluster, must be unique within your account

network_id.description: The network for the cluster, if not declared, the default one is used

tags.description: Space separated list of tags, to be used freely as required

write_kubeconfig.description: When set to true, kubeconfig is saved to the terraform state file
